item.description:
# Draftava 1.3.9
- Adds **File → Recover Archived Draft as Copy…** for preserved document conflict versions. - Lets you review archived Markdown before recovering it as a separate draft. - Keeps the original document intact and creates a pre-recovery History backup. - Verifies the recovered Markdown after saving. - Includes groundwork for document-level conflict tracking and recovery.
Automatic cross-Mac conflict reconciliation is not enabled in this release.
